app_builder_apps_installation_public_uq.name: app_builder_apps_installation_public_uq
app_builder_apps_installation_public_uq.where: "app_builder_apps"."desktop_installation_id" is not null and "app_builder_apps"."app_public_id" is not null

app_builder_apps_installation_binding_uq.name: app_builder_apps_installation_binding_uq
app_builder_apps_installation_binding_uq.where: "app_builder_apps"."desktop_installation_id" is not null and "app_builder_apps"."local_binding_id" is not null

app_builder_apps_binding_all_or_none_che.name: app_builder_apps_binding_all_or_none_check
app_builder_apps_binding_all_or_none_che.value:
(
        ("app_builder_apps"."desktop_installation_id" is null and "app_builder_apps"."app_public_id" is null and "app_builder_apps"."local_binding_id" is null)
        or
        ("app_builder_apps"."desktop_installation_id" is not null and "app_builder_apps"."app_public_id" is not null and "app_builder_apps"."local_binding_id" is not null)
      )

agent_custom_integration_bindings_owner_.name: agent_custom_integration_bindings_owner_check
agent_custom_integration_bindings_owner_.value: "agent_custom_integration_bindings"."integration_id" is not null or "agent_custom_integration_bindings"."connection_id" is not null

custom_integration_tool_calls_owner_chec.name: custom_integration_tool_calls_owner_check
custom_integration_tool_calls_owner_chec.value: "custom_integration_tool_calls"."integration_id" is not null or "custom_integration_tool_calls"."connection_id" is not null

custom_integration_tools_owner_check.name: custom_integration_tools_owner_check
custom_integration_tools_owner_check.value: "custom_integration_tools"."integration_id" is not null or "custom_integration_tools"."connection_id" is not null

heartbeat_run_attempts_owner_fence_shape.name: heartbeat_run_attempts_owner_fence_shape_check
heartbeat_run_attempts_owner_fence_shape.value:
(
        ("heartbeat_run_attempts"."owner_token" is null and "heartbeat_run_attempts"."attempt_epoch" is null)
        or
        ("heartbeat_run_attempts"."owner_token" is not null and btrim("heartbeat_run_attempts"."owner_token") <> '' and "heartbeat_run_attempts"."attempt_epoch" is not null and "heartbeat_run_attempts"."attempt_epoch" > 0)
      )

heartbeat_runs_active_chat_conversation_.name: heartbeat_runs_active_chat_conversation_uq
heartbeat_runs_active_chat_conversation_.where: "heartbeat_runs"."chat_conversation_id" is not null and ("heartbeat_runs"."status" in ('queued', 'running') or "heartbeat_runs"."terminal_effects_pending" = true)

heartbeat_runs_common_run_identity_check.name: heartbeat_runs_common_run_identity_check
heartbeat_runs_common_run_identity_check.value:
(
        ("heartbeat_runs"."scene" is null and "heartbeat_runs"."target_type" is null and "heartbeat_runs"."target_id" is null
          and "heartbeat_runs"."idempotency_key" is null and "heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json" is null)
        or
        ("heartbeat_runs"."scene" is not null and "heartbeat_runs"."target_type" is not null and "heartbeat_runs"."target_id" is not null
          and "heartbeat_runs"."idempotency_key" is not null and "heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json" is not null)
      )

heartbeat_runs_target_check.name: heartbeat_runs_target_check
heartbeat_runs_target_check.value:
(
        ("heartbeat_runs"."target_type" is null and "heartbeat_runs"."target_id" is null)
        or
        ("heartbeat_runs"."target_type" is not null and "heartbeat_runs"."target_type" in ('issue', 'chat_conversation', 'chat_message', 'automation_run', 'wakeup_request', 'manual', 'review')
          and "heartbeat_runs"."target_id" is not null and "heartbeat_runs"."target_id" = btrim("heartbeat_runs"."target_id") and btrim("heartbeat_runs"."target_id") <> '')
      )

heartbeat_runs_idempotency_key_check.name: heartbeat_runs_idempotency_key_check
heartbeat_runs_idempotency_key_check.value: "heartbeat_runs"."idempotency_key" is null or ("heartbeat_runs"."idempotency_key" = btrim("heartbeat_runs"."idempotency_key") and octet_length("heartbeat_runs"."idempotency_key") between 1 and 512)

heartbeat_runs_session_intent_shape_chec.name: heartbeat_runs_session_intent_shape_check
heartbeat_runs_session_intent_shape_chec.value:
(
        "heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json" is null
        or (
          jsonb_typeof("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json") = 'object'
          and "heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json" ?& array['kind', 'reuseScope', 'sourceRunId', 'sessionId', 'sessionParams']
          and jsonb_typeof("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->'kind') = 'string'
          and jsonb_typeof("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->'reuseScope') = 'string'
          and "heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'kind' in ('fresh', 'resume', 'fork')
          and (
            (
              "heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'kind' = 'fresh'
              and "heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'reuseScope' = 'none'
              and jsonb_typeof("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->'sourceRunId') = 'null'
              and jsonb_typeof("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->'sessionId') = 'null'
              and jsonb_typeof("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->'sessionParams') = 'null'
              and not ("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json" ? 'sourceBoundaryRef')
            )
            or
            (
              "heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'kind' = 'resume'
              and "heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'reuseScope' in ('explicit', 'task')
              and (
                jsonb_typeof("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->'sourceRunId') = 'null'
                or (jsonb_typeof("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->'sourceRunId') = 'string' and "heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'sourceRunId' = btrim("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'sourceRunId') and btrim("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'sourceRunId') <> '')
              )
              and (
                jsonb_typeof("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->'sessionId') = 'null'
                or (jsonb_typeof("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->'sessionId') = 'string' and "heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'sessionId' = btrim("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'sessionId') and btrim("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'sessionId') <> '')
              )
              and jsonb_typeof("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->'sessionParams') in ('null', 'object')
              and not ("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json" ? 'sourceBoundaryRef')
            )
            or
            (
              "heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'kind' = 'fork'
              and "heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'reuseScope' = 'explicit'
              and jsonb_typeof("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->'sourceRunId') = 'string'
              and "heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'sourceRunId' = btrim("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'sourceRunId')
              and btrim("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'sourceRunId') <> ''
              and "heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json" ? 'sourceBoundaryRef'
              and jsonb_typeof("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->'sourceBoundaryRef') = 'string'
              and "heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'sourceBoundaryRef' = btrim("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'sourceBoundaryRef')
              and btrim("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'sourceBoundaryRef') <> ''
              and (
                jsonb_typeof("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->'sessionId') = 'null'
                or (jsonb_typeof("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->'sessionId') = 'string' and "heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'sessionId' = btrim("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'sessionId') and btrim("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->>'sessionId') <> '')
              )
              and jsonb_typeof("heartbeat_runs"."session_intent_json"->'sessionParams') in ('null', 'object')
            )
          )
        )
      )

issues_open_automation_execution_uq.name: issues_open_automation_execution_uq
issues_open_automation_execution_uq.where:
"issues"."origin_kind" = 'automation_execution'
          and "issues"."origin_id" is not null
          and "issues"."origin_run_id" is not null
          and "issues"."hidden_at" is null
          and "issues"."execution_run_id" is not null
          and "issues"."status" in ('backlog', 'todo', 'in_progress', 'in_review', 'blocked')

mcp_connections_scope_owner_check.name: mcp_connections_scope_owner_check
mcp_connections_scope_owner_check.value: ("mcp_connections"."scope" = 'organization' and "mcp_connections"."owner_agent_id" is null) or ("mcp_connections"."scope" = 'agent' and "mcp_connections"."owner_agent_id" is not null)

native_segments_sealed_lifecycle_check.name: native_segments_sealed_lifecycle_check
native_segments_sealed_lifecycle_check.value:
(
        ("native_segments"."state" in ('pending', 'open') and "native_segments"."sealed_at" is null)
        or ("native_segments"."state" in ('sealed', 'superseded') and "native_segments"."sealed_at" is not null)
      )

run_runtime_spans_closed_lifecycle_check.name: run_runtime_spans_closed_lifecycle_check
run_runtime_spans_closed_lifecycle_check.value:
(
        ("run_runtime_spans"."state" = 'open' and "run_runtime_spans"."closed_at" is null)
        or ("run_runtime_spans"."state" in ('sealed', 'unresolved') and "run_runtime_spans"."closed_at" is not null)
      )

runtime_bindings_org_target_uq.name: runtime_bindings_org_target_uq
runtime_bindings_org_target_uq.where: "runtime_bindings"."status" = 'active' and "runtime_bindings"."target_type" is not null and "runtime_bindings"."target_id" is not null

runtime_bindings_org_target_epoch_uq.name: runtime_bindings_org_target_epoch_uq
runtime_bindings_org_target_epoch_uq.where: "runtime_bindings"."target_type" is not null and "runtime_bindings"."target_id" is not null

runtime_bindings_target_shape_check.name: runtime_bindings_target_shape_check
runtime_bindings_target_shape_check.value:
(
        ("runtime_bindings"."target_type" is null and "runtime_bindings"."target_id" is null and "runtime_bindings"."conversation_id" is not null)
        or
        ("runtime_bindings"."target_type" is not null and "runtime_bindings"."target_type" = 'chat_conversation'
          and "runtime_bindings"."target_id" is not null
          and btrim("runtime_bindings"."target_id") <> ''
          and "runtime_bindings"."conversation_id" is not null
          and "runtime_bindings"."target_id" = "runtime_bindings"."conversation_id"::text)
        or
        ("runtime_bindings"."target_type" is not null and "runtime_bindings"."target_type" in ('issue', 'chat_message', 'automation_run', 'wakeup_request', 'manual', 'review')
          and "runtime_bindings"."target_id" is not null
          and btrim("runtime_bindings"."target_id") <> ''
          and "runtime_bindings"."conversation_id" is null)
      )

runtime_retention_claims_lifecycle_check.name: runtime_retention_claims_lifecycle_check
runtime_retention_claims_lifecycle_check.value:
(
        ("runtime_retention_claims"."status" = 'active' and "runtime_retention_claims"."released_at" is null)
        or ("runtime_retention_claims"."status" = 'released' and "runtime_retention_claims"."released_at" is not null)
        or ("runtime_retention_claims"."status" = 'expired' and "runtime_retention_claims"."expires_at" is not null and "runtime_retention_claims"."released_at" is null)
      )

runtime_retention_claims_timestamp_order.name: runtime_retention_claims_timestamp_order_check
runtime_retention_claims_timestamp_order.value:
(
        ("runtime_retention_claims"."expires_at" is null or "runtime_retention_claims"."expires_at" >= "runtime_retention_claims"."created_at")
        and ("runtime_retention_claims"."released_at" is null or "runtime_retention_claims"."released_at" >= "runtime_retention_claims"."created_at")
      )

runtime_source_aliases_timestamp_order_c.name: runtime_source_aliases_timestamp_order_check
runtime_source_aliases_timestamp_order_c.value:
(
        ("runtime_source_aliases"."expires_at" is null or "runtime_source_aliases"."expires_at" >= "runtime_source_aliases"."created_at")
        and ("runtime_source_aliases"."released_at" is null or "runtime_source_aliases"."released_at" >= "runtime_source_aliases"."created_at")
      )
